## Description

This routing profile directs Russian websites and IP addresses through a direct connection (bypassing the VPN), while routing all other traffic through the proxy.

### Direct Routes:
- get-myip.com (for testing)
- www.get-myip.com (for testing)
- geosite:category-ru (all Russian websites)
- geoip:ru (all Russian IP addresses)
- geoip:private (private/local IP ranges)

### DNS Configuration:
- Remote DNS: Cloudflare DoH (1.1.1.1)
- Domestic DNS: Google DoH (8.8.8.8)

## Usage

Scan the QR code with Happ app to import this routing profile.
